ARCHITECTURE: Next.js local web app (not VS Code extension). Each Claude Code terminal session = pixel art worker in an office grid. Boss character = Ned.
HOW IT WORKS:
- Claude Code hooks POST events to localhost:3000 on PreToolUse/PostToolUse/Stop
- App registers each session as a worker, tracks what they're doing in real-time
- Workers animate based on activity (reading, writing, waiting)
- LOW RISK (read/grep/glob/ls): auto-approved, worker just does it
- MEDIUM RISK (file edits within project): auto-approved
- HIGH RISK (git push, delete files, install packages, unknown commands): speech bubble appears, boss clicks approve/deny
- Workers learn over time — first time they do X, ask boss; after approval, auto-approve next time
REFERENCES: Pixel Agents (visual layer), Executive (hooks pattern)
STATUS: Built and shipped. Public GitHub. LinkedIn post got 15 reactions.
